svg.text: KitaPay · Regional Digital Wallet & Payments Platform
Azure reference architecture · cell-based · zone-redundant · 20,000 TPS design peak · 18M wallets (Malaysia + Singapore)
CELL A · Malaysia West (Kuala Lumpur) · 3 availability zones · home cell for MY users
SPOKE VNET · payments-prod · private endpoints only · no public IPs
AKS · 3 AZs · system / payments / risk node pools · Istio mesh · KEDA · Workload Identity
pods spread across zones · topologySpreadConstraints · PDBs · min 3 replicas
Ledger txn commits state change + outbox row atomically;
relay publishes to Service Bus / Event Hubs (at-least-once)
Consumers are idempotent by message-id · DLQ + replay runbook
STATE · all access via Private Endpoints
3 AZs · home cell for SG users · DR for Cell A
SG home shards + secondaries of Cell A
BNM / MAS extracts built from the
• Workload Identity everywhere — no stored secrets · PIM just-in-time for humans
• Signed images + admission policy · Policy denies public IPs and non-CMK storage
• Customer-managed keys in Managed HSM · detection-as-code in Sentinel · PAN never enters scope
• auth success rate · p99 latency · ledger commit lag
• saga stuck-count · queue age · replication lag
• burn-rate alerts (1 h / 6 h) · synthetic probes KL + SG / 30 s
• Rings: canary 1% Cell B → 10% → Cell A · expand/contract DB migrations
• Quarterly game days: AZ loss · shard failover · Redis flush · rail brownout · region evacuation
• Bicep/Terraform on an Azure Landing Zone · policy-as-code · SLSA-style provenance
Front Door: TLS · WAF · bot rules
Entra External ID: MFA step-up → JWT
